rows.grounds: ablative indicating source or occasion of benefit

items.question: What ritual efficacy follows from bathing at Ballabhā and seeing Nīlakaṇṭha?
premises: A person bathes at the place called Ballabhā.
The same person has sight of Nīlakaṇṭha.
The act of seeing Nīlakaṇṭha is presented as efficacious.
items.inference: Bathing at Ballabhā and beholding Nīlakaṇṭha together constitute a ritually efficacious act.
uncertainties: The specific fruit of this act may be stated in a following verse.
The precise identification of Ballabhā as a site is not specified here.
items.plain_english: Having bathed at Ballabhā, a person obtains the benefit that comes from seeing Nīlakaṇṭha.
